scripts.build: npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run build && npm run db:migrate:remote && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.db:migrate:local: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply bloodchain_db --local
scripts.db:migrate:remote: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply bloodchain_db --remote
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run db:migrate:remote && npx wrangler deploy
